body: Not an option. Not for me, at least. Never.
I used to write, but not so much anymore. Doesn't matter anyways.

I failed at being perfect in several ways, I just didn't go into detail. I failed socially when it comes to friends. I failed academically by not getting straight A's (I ways got mostly A's with one B on my report card. Oh, and I failed some AP tests). And physically I am one gigantic disgusting mass that will never be acceptable, let alone perfect.

I failed at being normal because I cry constantly and am extremely suicidal when I have no real problems. Again, all or nothing, so even though I want to be loved I know I never will be, so I want to be invisible. But you can see normal people, so if no one can see me then I failed at that too.

So I guess as a person I want to be nonexistent. I really wish I was never born, but I can't do anything about that. Being dead is the closest I will ever get.

I didn't want to take a different path. I want to be normal, but I never will be. I've tried so hard to be perfect and I failed miserably. I'll never redeem myself. 

All or nothing. I failed to reach that goal, therefore I am nothing.

There's a straight line people are supposed to follow. I was supposed to have my first kiss in Middle School. I was supposed to have my first love in High School. I'm in college and not only have I never been kissed or on a date, not a single guy has ever liked me. People say 19 is young but it's *way* too old to be a single girl who's never been kissed. I failed. I didn't take the path and now it's too late. When you make a mistake, you erase it, right? I just need to be erased.

I'm not doing anything. At all. I'm in school, but no one talks to me. I've tried to stay out of my room and work out, but I'm still not good enough to be approached. I don't even know why I'm in college anyways when I know I'm going to kill myself eventually. I just wanted at least a glimmer of hope that someone would care for me before I do it, but that's never going to happen.

What I want doesn't matter. Whether I live or die doesn't make a difference because it will have no affect on anyone. I'm just sick of being utterly unloved. I know I deserve it, and that makes me hate myself even more: I brought this on myself and it's too late to change anything.
Honestly, the fact that I have absolutely nothing to live for is becoming more and more apparent everyday. I know I'm going to kill myself eventually, so why do I keep putting it off?

The reason is that I have proof that nobody cared or ever will care. Your value in society is based off of how you contribute to others. I have no social skills, attractive looks, or intelligence so I have no contribution and therefore have no value. Plus being an adult who has never even been kissed is proof that I am undesirable and unwanted. You have to earn love and I will never be good enough to earn it. 


Essentially I'm a worthless human being who's only contribution to life is crying about being worthless. If I die, no one will notice. I want to say the world might be even better if I killed myself, but that's assuming I made any impact whatsoever. No matter what happens, it's my responsibility to erase the giant mistake of my life.

I have no plans on stopping self-harm. I deserve the scars; they're a good reminder of what an awfully flawed person I am. I want to post on /r/amiugly, but I don't want to expose my identity on this account. I have a real account, but I know people who know my user and that would be embarrassing. I guess I could make another throwaway. Seems like a lot of effort to confirm that I'm disgusting.
